title: On the Origin and Evolution of Training-Inference Mismatch in LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.40945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy reinforcement learning for large language models assumes that training responses are sampled from the current policy. In practice, an inference engine samples the responses and a separate trainer computes the gradients, and the \textbf{training-inference mismatch} between the two makes the training data off-policy. The mismatch has two sources, the numerics of the engine and the stale weights of asynchronous sampling, and a correction that stabilizes training under one source can fail under the other. \textit{We ask which property of a mismatch source decides the correction it needs.} Evaluating the trainer at the sampler's weights splits each sampled-token error exactly into a \textit{numerical discrepancy} of the engine and a \textit{policy lag} of the trainer, and we follow both through training. The numerical discrepancy stays approximately constant, so it biases the updates by a nearly fixed amount, and centering the score

translated_title: 论大语言模型强化学习中训练-推理失配的起源与演化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的在策略强化学习假设训练响应是从当前策略中采样得到的。在实际中，由推理引擎对响应进行采样，而由另一个独立的训练器计算梯度，二者之间的训练-推理失配使得训练数据偏离了当前策略。这种失配有两个来源：引擎的数值计算特性以及异步采样中的过期权重，而针对其中一个来源能够稳定训练的修正方法在另一个来源下可能失效。我们提出的问题是：失配源的哪种性质决定了它所需要的修正方法。通过在采样器的权重处评估训练器，可以将每个采样 token 的误差精确地分解为引擎的数值差异和训练器的策略滞后两部分，并贯穿整个训练过程对这两者进行追踪。数值差异保持近似恒定，因此它会以几乎固定的量使更新产生偏倚，而对得分进行中心化……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将大语言模型强化学习中的训练-推理失配精确分解为推理引擎的数值差异与训练器的策略滞后两个来源，并追踪二者在训练过程中的不同演化规律，以揭示各自所需的修正方法。
en_tdlr: This paper exactly decomposes the training-inference mismatch in LLM reinforcement learning into a numerical discrepancy of the inference engine and a policy lag of the trainer, tracking their distinct evolution during training to determine the correction each source requires.
